title: Tax break for Fordham Bedford Cluster housing, Bronx
summary: Resolution granting a property tax exemption for an affordable housing project at Block 3304, Lot 156 and Block 3324, Lot 99 in the Bronx, owned by a housing development fund company. The exemption would run for up to 40 years from June 25, 2021 and is tied to compliance with an affordable housing regulatory agreement with the Department of Housing Preservation and Development.
